program: M&F AI Lab Strata serving lane - N-scaling acceptance (M0 instruments)
authority: master plan 2026-10-02-strata-agentic-engine-acceleration-master-plan.md section 11.5 (finish line + channel conventions)

reading.per_agent_prefill: engine prompt tokens of that agent's request / (client first streamed token time - fire time), full fleet loaded
reading.aggregate: same-run sum over agents; burst leg: sum(prompt tokens) / fleet wall until last prompt completes; pump cross-check: sum(prompt tokens) / sum(engine prompt_ms) (equal for the serial pump)
reading.per_agent_decode: committed tokens over the steady decode window (done-line channel), full fleet active
reading.retained_ttft: the same on a re-sent conversation turn whose prefix the engine already holds
reading.shapes: declared in ENGINE tokens, asserted within +-2 percent every run
reading.busy_reading: engine-busy arithmetic is a diagnostic only, never a gate (a reruling divides every cell by N identically)
reading.decode_channels_binding: every decode claim NAMES its channel: deep-streak | sustained-steady | all-retained (master plan 11.5)

channels.deep-streak: 1024-token concurrent single-shot burst; statistic = per-request engine done-line decode tok/s; judged as min-agent + cross-agent median (recorded class: 65.4/65.6 flipped, 43.3 bounded, R1 61.3/61.6 vs 42.9/42.4)
channels.sustained-steady: multi-turn workload instrument; per-agent p50 of done-line decode over the post-ramp steady window (turns >= steady_min_turn, default 4) -> cross-agent median; variants reported: post-ramp (turns >= 3), turns 4-6, all-retained (recorded: 53.5/51.2 t4-6; 48.8/48.4 post-ramp)
channels.all-retained: multi-turn workload instrument; per-agent p50 of done-line decode over retained turns (turn >= 2, ok; gen_tokens >= 128 filter with <20-qualifying-rows fallback) -> cross-agent median (recorded: 36.0/38.9; the decision-grade sustained channel)

anchors: est 120000 -> engine 87473..87852 (coder IQ1_M pack; measured on 2026-10-02 receipts)
a receipt sized at engine_target/0.729 must land within +-2 percent or the run recalibrates the factor
